description: The Hub Power Company Limited (HUBCO) is Pakistan's first and one of its largest independent power producers, with a combined installed generation capacity of 2,289 MW. Its original plant at Mouza Kund in Hub, Balochistan is one of the most efficient furnace-oil-fired thermal stations in the country. The group has since diversified into imported-coal and Thar lignite generation, oil and gas exploration, coal mining, and operations and maintenance services. Through its subsidiary Hub Power Holdings, it also holds an electric-vehicle venture with BYD Auto Industry Company Limited in Pakistan.
